relationships.subject: Fasudil
relationships.evidence_quote: Fasudil (30 μM) and Y27632 (30 μM), Rho-kinase inhibitors [35], were also confirmed to suppress the phosphorylation of cofilin induced by the simultaneous stimulation of the combination

relationships.subject: Fasudil
relationships.evidence_quote: However, neither fasudil nor Y27632 affected the platelet aggregation stimulated synergistically by the combination

key_findings: Tramadol and SSRIs/SNRI, but not morphine or reboxetine, suppressed collagen plus CXCL12 platelet activation via Rac upstream of p38 MAPK/HSP27.
Rho-kinase inhibitors fasudil and Y27632 blocked cofilin phosphorylation but did not affect platelet aggregation, so Rho/ROCK is not involved.
